title: Who will win the women's 800m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships?
resolution_criteria:

  Resolution : Resolve to the swimmer awarded the gold medal in the women's 800m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships, once the final result is announced.
